author: implementation-agent

findings.summary: The Quick Search trigger is implemented as an anchor pretending to be a button.
findings.consequence: The control is keyboard-operable today because Enter and Space handlers are manually added, but it still duplicates native button behavior and can drift from expected semantics for disabled state, form behavior, or future interaction changes.
findings.evidence: The component template renders the Snabbsökning control as `<a role="button" tabindex="0">` with manual key handlers instead of a native `<button type="button">`. The surrounding stylesheet also resets `.mainnav .quick-search-trigger` to button-like presentation, so no link navigation behavior is being preserved.
findings.recommendation: Use `<button type="button" class="quick-search-trigger">Snabbsökning</button>` and keep the existing click handler, title, ref, and styling. Drop the manual Enter/Space handlers unless tests show custom keyboard behavior is still needed.
